compute_metrics_coco_occluded: compute metrics from processed detection results including standard COCO and occluded separated recall
evaluate_occluded_separated_masks: evaluate recall of occluded and separated masks from detection results and print summary table
compute_recall_occluded_separated: compute recall of occluded or separated masks by matching detections against ground truth annotations
mask_iou_calculation: compute IoU between two binary numpy masks using intersection over union formula
init_coco_occluded_metric: initialize CocoOccludedSeparatedMetric with occluded and separated annotation paths and configurable score and IoU thresholds
